name: RENK Group AG
summary: RENK Group AG specializes in manufacturing and delivering vital drive solutions, serving a broad spectrum of both commercial and defense sectors. Its comprehensive product range encompasses gear units, transmissions, power-packs, hybrid propulsion systems, suspension systems, slide bearings, couplings and clutches, and various test systems. The enterprise was founded by Johann Julius Renk in 1873 and is based in Augsburg, Germany.
